exposure: non-contrast 3D steady-state free-precession (SSFP) magnetic resonance angiography (MRA)
cohort: 15 pregnant subjects with positive genotyping for aortopathy (Marfan, Loeys-Dietz, Ehlers-Danlos) and/or a family history of aortic dissection
finding: Non-contrast SSFP MRA imaging is a quick and reproducible method of assessing the thoracic aorta in pregnancy.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery was vaginal in 9 out of 15 subjects (60%).
